scripts.test: vp run test:unit && vp run test:effect-codex && vp run test:core-client && vp run test:main && vp run test:renderer && vp run test:integration
scripts.test:core-client: cargo build -p nodex-core-server && vp test run --config vitest.core-client.config.ts
scripts.test:core-client:related: cargo build -p nodex-core-server && vp test related --run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.core-client.config.ts
scripts.test:main: vp run core:test-support:build:dev && node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --config vitest.main.config.ts
scripts.test:main:related: vp run core:test-support:build:dev && node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --command related --run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.main.config.ts
scripts.test:integration:ci: vp run core:test-support:build:dev && vp run test:integration

scripts.test:main:stress: vp run core:test-support:build:dev && NODEX_TEST_TIER=stress node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --config vitest.main.config.ts
scripts.test:stress: vp run build-resources:prepare && vp run test:unit:stress && vp run test:main:stress && vp run test:renderer:stress && vp run test:browser:stress && vp run test:integration:stress

scripts.agent:smoke:scripted: vp run stage:codex-runtime:mac:cached && vp run test:e2e tests/e2e/scripted-agent-runtime.spec.ts
scripts.test:performance: vp run core:benchmark:rust && vp run core:test:scale
scripts.codex:schemas:generate: vp run stage:codex-runtime:mac && tsx scripts/codex-schemas.ts generate
scripts.codex:schemas:verify: vp run stage:codex-runtime:mac && vp run codex:schemas:verify:staged
scripts.test:agent-runtime-conformance: vp run stage:codex-runtime:mac && vp run test:agent-runtime-conformance:staged

scripts.test:browser-runtime-conformance: vp run stage:codex-runtime:mac && vp run browser-runtime:probe && vp run browser-runtime:conformance
scripts.core:test: vp run core:test:full && vp run core:test:nightly
scripts.core:test:pr: vp run core:test:nextest && vp run core:test:docs

scripts.core:build:mac:arm64: MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=15.0 cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p nodex-core-server -p nodex-cli -p nodex-browser-profile-helper && tsx scripts/stage-rust-core.ts --target-arch arm64 --out .generated/rust-core-runtime/arm64
scripts.core:build:mac:x64: MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=15.0 cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -p nodex-core-server -p nodex-cli -p nodex-browser-profile-helper && tsx scripts/stage-rust-core.ts --target-arch x64 --out .generated/rust-core-runtime/x64
scripts.core:benchmark:rust: cargo build --release -p nodex-core-server && NODEX_MEASURE_RUST_CORE_RUNTIME=1 vp test run --config vitest.core-client.config.ts src/main/core-client/rust-core-runtime-benchmark.node.test.ts
scripts.core:test:electron-authority: cargo build -p nodex-core-server --all-targets && node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --config vitest.integration.config.ts src/main/rust-data-authority.integration.ts
scripts.core:test:packaged-cli-electron: node -e "if (!process.env.NODEX_PACKAGED_CLI) throw new Error('NODEX_PACKAGED_CLI is required')" && node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --config vitest.integration.config.ts src/main/native-cli-electron.integration.ts
scripts.stage:sparkle-runtime:mac:arm64: vp run materialize:sparkle:mac && tsx scripts/build-sparkle-bridge.ts --arch arm64 --channel ${NODEX_SPARKLE_CHANNEL:-disabled} --out .generated/sparkle-runtime/arm64
scripts.stage:sparkle-runtime:mac:x64: vp run materialize:sparkle:mac && tsx scripts/build-sparkle-bridge.ts --arch x64 --channel ${NODEX_SPARKLE_CHANNEL:-disabled} --out .generated/sparkle-runtime/x64

scripts.stage:codex-runtime:mac:arm64: vp run materialize:browser-runtime:mac:arm64 && tsx scripts/stage-codex-runtime.ts --target-platform darwin --target-arch arm64 --out .generated/codex-runtime --browser-runtime-source .generated/browser-runtime-source/arm64
scripts.stage:codex-runtime:mac:x64: vp run materialize:browser-runtime:mac:x64 && tsx scripts/stage-codex-runtime.ts --target-platform darwin --target-arch x64 --out .generated/codex-runtime --browser-runtime-source .generated/browser-runtime-source/x64

scripts.stage:native-runtime:mac:x64: vp run clipboard-bridge:build x64 && vp run stage:codex-runtime:mac:x64 && MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=15.0 cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -p nodex-core-server -p nodex-cli -p nodex-browser-profile-helper && tsx scripts/stage-rust-core.ts --target-arch x64 --out .generated/codex-runtime && vp run stage:sparkle-runtime:mac:x64
